body:
Turn this character image into a seamless looping GIF, 12 frames at 100 ms per frame. Action: the character spins the staff in their hand, releases a small burst of sparkles, then returns to the starting pose. Keep the design, colors, proportions and line art the same as the original in every frame. Full body in frame, fixed camera, plain pure white background, no text.

Production adaptation: The text above defines the visual idea and action. For this call output only ONE PNG SPRITE SHEET, NOT a GIF file: exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, chronological row-major order. No border, grid lines, gutters, frame numbers, timestamps, or extra text. Fixed camera and ground line unless the action explicitly moves the camera. Keep scale, character identity, palette and geometry consistent; each cell is one distinctly different consecutive animation pose with nothing crossing cell boundaries. Cells will be extracted and encoded locally afterward. Make the motion return naturally from the final cell to the first.
Exactly twelve distinct chronological poses: staff rotates in the hand through a full turn over frames 1–8, sparkles appear at 9–10, fade at 11, ready pose at 12. No timecodes, no numbers, no written text.

en.body:
## How to use

Upload the 1 project-generated reference image(s) in the displayed order (R18), then use the complete adapted prompt.

Generate one PNG sheet, extract 12 cells in row-major order, and encode them with the recorded delays and loop setting. The GIF is composed locally; the image tool returned a still PNG. The source sheet, exact crops, frame delays and first-frame poster are retained in the campaign archive.

## Result and limitations

12 frames, 1.2 seconds, 362×362px; repeats indefinitely. GPT Image frame-sheet + local GIF encoding.

Twelve distinct staff orientations and sparkle phases are drawn in chronological order. Full body and staff remain within each cell; no timestamps or text. Minor redraw variation in staff length is visible. Encoded 12 frames at 100 ms, infinite loop, 1200 ms total.

## Source

Adapted by Prompt Seen from [@Voxyz_ai's original prompt](https://x.com/Voxyz_ai/status/2118750260549796019). The author labels the source work Image 2.6; this run only establishes the GPT Image family, with no exact model ID. The prompt preserves its submitted language on both page editions. Likes describe the whole source post, shared by variants, and are not engagement for this example.
